title: 4-vector Justification
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly justify that (c k, omega) is a relativistic 4-vector by relating it to the transformation properties of the components.

title: Frequency Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct formulas for the observed frequency when the atom is moving towards and away from the observer.

title: Correct Use of Lorentz Transform
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Lorentz transformation to relate the frequencies in different frames.

title: Clear Presentation
description: Important Criteria: The student should present the solution in a clear and logical manner, making it easy to follow the reasoning.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors when applying the Lorentz transformation, especially in the context of velocities.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation, particularly when dealing with frequency and wave vectors.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases, such as low velocities compared to the speed of light, to validate the results.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explore alternative methods or approaches to derive the frequency transformations, demonstrating deeper understanding.
